units.en: In the first year of the Yuanshou era, on the new moon of the first month, day xinchou, there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: In the first year of Yuanshou, on the new moon of the first month, day xinchou, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 丁巳，皇太太后傅氏崩。
units.en: On the day dingsi, Grand Empress Dowager Fu died.
units.literal: On the day dingsi, Grand Empress Dowager Fu passed away.

units.zh: 二年春正月，匈奴單于、烏孫大昆彌來朝。
units.en: In the first month of spring of the second year, the Xiongnu chanyu and the Wusun great kunmi paid court visits.
units.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, the Xiongnu Chanyu and Wusun Great Kunmi came to court.

units.zh: 年三歲嗣立為王，長好文辭法律。
units.en: At the age of three, he succeeded as king, and as he grew up he came to favor literary composition and the study of law.
units.literal: At age three he succeeded to the throne as king, and when grown he favored literary compositions and laws.

units.zh: 成帝亦自美其材，為加元服而遣之，時年十七矣。
units.en: Emperor Cheng himself admired the young man's talents, performed the coming-of-age capping ceremony for him, and sent him back home. He was seventeen at the time.
units.literal: Emperor Cheng himself admired his abilities, performed the capping ceremony for him, and sent him away; he was then seventeen years old.

units.zh: 秋九月壬寅，葬義陵。
units.en: In the ninth month of autumn, on the day renyin, he was interred in the Yiling tomb.
units.literal: In the ninth month of autumn, on the day renyin, he was buried in the Yiling tomb.

units.zh: 詔曰：「漢興二百載，曆數開元。
units.en: An edict stated: "The Han has risen for two hundred years, and the cycle of fate opens a new beginning.
units.literal: An edict stated: "The Han has risen for two hundred years; the cycle of fate opens a new beginning.

units.zh: 即位痿痺，末年寖劇。
units.en: Upon ascending the throne, he suffered from paralysis; in his later years, the condition steadily deteriorated.
units.literal: Upon ascending the throne he had flaccid paralysis; in his final years it gradually worsened.

units.zh: 睹孝成世祿去王室，權柄外移，是故臨朝婁誅大臣，欲彊主威，以則武、宣。
units.en: Witnessing how in Emperor Cheng's era, hereditary stipends left the imperial family and power shifted to outsiders, he frequently executed ministers upon ascending the throne, seeking to strengthen imperial authority and emulate Emperors Wu and Xuan.
units.literal: He observed that in the generation of Filial Cheng, emoluments departed from the imperial house, authority shifted outward, therefore upon ascending the throne he frequently executed ministers, desiring to strengthen imperial authority, to follow Wu and Xuan.

units.zh: 雅性不好聲色，時覽卞射武戲。
units.en: His refined character showed no interest in music or sensual pleasures; he occasionally enjoyed watching archery contests and martial demonstrations.
units.literal: His elegant nature did not favor music and sex; he occasionally viewed archery and martial displays.

units.zh: 傅、相、中尉皆國二千石，故盡從之。」
units.en: The tutor, chancellor, and commandant are all two-thousand-bushel officials in my domain, so I brought them all with me.'
units.literal: The tutor, chancellor, and commandant are all officials of two thousand bushels in the state, so I brought all of them.'

units.zh: 上曰：「朕聞夫婦一體。
units.en: The emperor declared: 'I have heard that husband and wife are one flesh.
units.literal: The emperor said: 'I have heard that husband and wife are one body.

units.zh: 《詩》云：『穀則異室，死則同穴。』
units.en: The Book of Odes states: "In life they occupy different rooms, in death they share one grave."
units.literal: The Odes say: "While alive they dwell in separate chambers, in death they share the same tomb."

units.zh: 昔季武子成寑，杜氏之殯在西階下，請合葬而許之。
units.en: In ancient times, when Ji Wuzi had completed his funeral preparations, the coffin of his wife from the Du family lay at the western steps. He requested joint burial and was granted permission.
units.literal: Formerly Ji Wuzi completed his sleeping arrangements, the Du family's coffin was at the western steps, he requested joint burial and it was permitted.

units.zh: 附葬之禮，自周興焉。
units.en: The practice of joint burial originated with the Zhou dynasty.
units.literal: The rite of joint burial arose from the Zhou dynasty.

units.zh: 『郁郁乎文哉！
units.en: 'How elegant and civilized!
units.literal: 'How cultured and refined!

units.zh: 吾從周。』
units.en: I shall follow the Zhou tradition.'
units.literal: I follow the Zhou.'

units.zh: 孝子事亡如事存。
units.en: A dutiful son honors the dead as he would honor the living.
units.literal: A filial son serves the deceased as if serving the living.

units.zh: 帝太后宜起陵恭皇之園。」
units.en: The Imperial Empress Dowager should be buried in the grounds of Emperor Gong's tomb.'
units.literal: The Imperial Empress Dowager should have her tomb raised in Emperor Gong's park.'

units.zh: 謝曰：「臣幸得繼父守藩為諸侯王，材質不足以假充太子之宮。
units.en: He respectfully declined, saying: 'I am fortunate to have succeeded my father in holding my fief as a feudal king. My talents and character are inadequate to serve even temporarily as Crown Prince.
units.literal: He declined, saying: 'Your servant has fortunately succeeded his father in guarding the border as a feudal lord king. My abilities and qualities are insufficient to temporarily fill the position of Crown Prince.

units.zh: 陛下聖德寬仁，敬承祖宗，奉順神祇，宜蒙福祐子孫千億之報。
units.en: Your Majesty's wisdom and benevolence are boundless. You honor your ancestors and obey the gods, and surely you will be blessed with countless descendants.
units.literal: Your Majesty's sage virtue is broad and benevolent; reverently continuing the ancestors, complying with the spirits, you should receive blessed protection for your descendants numbering thousands and myriads.

units.zh: 臣願且得留國邸，旦夕奉問起居，俟有聖嗣，歸國守藩。」
units.en: I wish only to remain in my residence for now, serving you faithfully by inquiring daily about your well-being, until you have a worthy heir, and then return to guard my domain.'
units.literal: I wish to remain in my country's residence for now, morning and evening attending to your inquiries about your condition, awaiting a sage heir, then return to my country to guard the border.'

units.zh: 書奏，天子報聞。
units.en: The memorial was submitted, and the emperor acknowledged it.
units.literal: The memorial was presented; the Son of Heaven acknowledged receipt.

units.zh: 詔曰：「春秋『母以子貴』，尊定陶太后曰恭皇太后，丁姬曰恭皇后，各置左右詹事，食邑如長信宮、中宮。」
units.en: An imperial edict declared: 'As the Spring and Autumn Annals teach, "The mother gains honor through her son." The Empress Dowager of Dingtao shall be honored as Empress Dowager Gong, and Lady Ding as Empress Gong. Each shall have their own attendants, with estates equal to the Changxin Palace and the imperial residence.'
units.literal: An edict stated: 'The Spring and Autumn Annals say "The mother is honored through the son." Honor the Empress Dowager of Dingtao as Empress Dowager Gong, and Lady Ding as Empress Gong. Each shall have left and right palace attendants established, with fiefs equal to the Changxin Palace and the Central Palace.'

units.zh: 六月，詔曰：「鄭聲淫而亂樂，聖王所放，其罷樂府。」
units.en: In the sixth month, an imperial edict declared: 'The decadent music of Zheng confuses proper ritual music; the sage kings banished it. We shall abolish the Music Bureau.'
units.literal: In the sixth month, an edict stated: 'Zheng music is licentious and confuses ritual music; the sage kings banished it. We shall abolish the Music Bureau.'

units.zh: 詔曰：「河間王良喪太后三年，為宗室儀表，益封萬戶。」
units.en: An imperial edict declared: 'King Liang of Hejian mourned his mother for three years, setting an example for the entire imperial clan. His fief shall be increased by ten thousand households.'
units.literal: An edict stated: 'King Liang of Hejian mourned his empress dowager for three years, serving as a model for the imperial clan. His fief shall be increased by ten thousand households.'

units.zh: 又曰：「制節謹度以防奢淫，為政所先，百王不易之道也。
units.en: Another edict declared: 'Controlling expenditures and maintaining proper standards to prevent extravagance and immorality is the highest priority in governance. This is the eternal principle followed by all wise rulers.
units.literal: Another edict stated: 'Moderating expenditures and being careful with standards to prevent extravagance and licentiousness is the foremost matter in governing. It is the unchanging way of the hundred kings.

units.zh: 諸侯王、列侯、公主、吏二千石及豪富民多畜奴婢，田宅亡限，與民爭利，百姓失職，重困不足。
units.en: Feudal kings, marquises, princesses, high officials, and wealthy families accumulate vast numbers of slaves and servants, owning unlimited fields and estates. They compete with ordinary people for profits, leaving the common folk unemployed and suffering from severe poverty.
units.literal: Feudal lords, marquises, princesses, officials of two thousand bushels, and wealthy commoners extensively accumulate slaves and bondservants, fields and dwellings without limit, contending with the people for profit. The common people lose their occupations, suffering doubly from hardship and insufficiency.

units.zh: 其議限列。」
units.en: Let the officials discuss and establish proper limits.'
units.literal: Let there be discussion of establishing limits.'

units.zh: 詔曰：「朕承宗廟之重，戰戰兢兢，懼失天心。
units.en: An imperial edict declared: 'I bear the sacred trust of our ancestral temples, filled with trepidation, fearing lest I lose Heaven's favor.
units.literal: An edict stated: 'I bear the heavy responsibility of the ancestral temples, trembling with fear, afraid of losing the favor of heaven.

units.zh: 間者日月亡光，五星失行，郡國比比地動。
units.en: Recently, the sun and moon have been eclipsed, the five planets have wandered from their proper paths, and earthquakes have struck repeatedly throughout the commanderies and principalities.
units.literal: Recently the sun and moon have lost their light, the five planets have deviated from their courses, and earthquakes have occurred repeatedly in commanderies and states.

units.zh: 乃者河南、穎川郡水出，流殺人民，壞敗廬舍。
units.en: Recently, flooding in Henan and Yingchuan commanderies has drowned people and destroyed homes and shelters.
units.literal: Recently in Henan and Yingchuan commanderies water overflowed, flooding and killing people, destroying houses and dwellings.

units.zh: 朕之不德，民反蒙辜，朕甚懼焉。
units.en: My lack of virtue has caused the people to suffer unjustly; I am deeply alarmed by this.
units.literal: Because of my lack of virtue, the people have conversely suffered unjustly; I am greatly fearful.

units.zh: 已遣光祿大夫循行舉籍，賜死者棺錢，人三千。
units.en: I have dispatched an Imperial Household Grandee to tour the affected areas and register the victims, granting three thousand cash for coffins to each of the dead.
units.literal: I have already dispatched an Imperial Household Grandee to tour and register them, granting coffin money to the dead, three thousand cash per person.

units.zh: 其令水所傷縣邑及他郡國災害什四以上，民貲不滿十萬，皆無出今年租賦。」
units.en: Order that counties and towns damaged by flooding, and other commanderies and states where disaster losses reach four-tenths or more, and where people's property is less than one hundred thousand cash, shall all be exempted from this year's rents and taxes.'
units.literal: Order that counties and towns damaged by water and other commanderies and states suffering disasters of four-tenths or more, people whose property is less than one hundred thousand, all shall not pay this year's rents and taxes.'

units.zh: 二月，詔曰：「蓋聞聖王之治，以得賢為首。
units.en: In the second month, an imperial edict declared: 'It is said that wise rulers prioritize finding worthy officials above all else.
units.literal: In the second month, an edict stated: 'I have heard that the governance of sage kings takes obtaining worthy men as the first priority.

units.zh: 其與大司馬、列侯、將軍、中二千石、州牧、守、相舉孝弟惇厚能直言通政事，延于側陋可親民者，各一人。」
units.en: Together with the Grand Commandant, marquises, generals, and officials of all ranks, let them recommend individuals who are filial and brotherly, sincere and upright, able to speak frankly and understand governance, including those from humble backgrounds who can connect with the people - one person each.'
units.literal: Let them together with the Grand Commandant, marquises, generals, officials of middle two thousand bushels, provincial governors, governors, and chancellors recommend filial and fraternal, sincere and substantial, able to speak directly and understand state affairs, extending to those in humble positions who can be close to the people, each one person.'

units.zh: 夏四月，詔曰：「漢家之制，推親親以顯尊尊。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, an imperial edict declared: 'The Han dynasty system honors relatives to demonstrate respect for superiors.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer, an edict stated: 'The Han system promotes kinship to manifest respect for superiors.

units.zh: 定陶恭皇之號不宜復稱定陶。
units.en: The title of Emperor Gong of Dingtao should no longer include the name Dingtao.
units.literal: Emperor Gong of Dingtao's designation should not again be called Dingtao.

units.zh: 尊恭皇太后曰帝太太后，稱永信宮；
units.en: Empress Dowager Gong shall be honored as Imperial Grand Empress Dowager, residing in the Yongxin Palace;
units.literal: Honor Empress Dowager Gong as Imperial Grand Empress Dowager, called the Yongxin Palace;

units.zh: 恭皇后曰帝太后，稱中安宮。
units.en: Empress Gong shall be honored as Imperial Empress Dowager, residing in the Zhong'an Palace.
units.literal: Empress Gong shall be called Imperial Empress Dowager, called the Zhong'an Palace.

units.zh: 立恭皇廟于京師。
units.en: A temple for Emperor Gong shall be established in the capital.
units.literal: Establish Emperor Gong's temple in the capital.

units.zh: 赦天下徒。」
units.en: All prisoners throughout the empire shall be granted amnesty.'
units.literal: Grant amnesty to convicts throughout the realm.'

units.zh: 八月，詔曰：「時詔夏賀良等建言改元易號，增益漏刻，可以永安國家。
units.en: In the eighth month, an imperial edict declared: 'Attendant-at-edict Xia Heliang and others proposed changing the reign title and extending the calendar periods, believing this would bring lasting stability to the nation.
units.literal: In the eighth month, an edict stated: 'Attendant-at-edict Xia Helang and others proposed changing the era name and designation, increasing the water clock periods, believing it could permanently secure the state.

units.zh: 朕過聽賀良等言，冀為海內獲福，卒亡嘉應。
units.en: I erroneously heeded the words of Helang and his associates, hoping to bring blessings to the entire realm, but ultimately received no favorable signs.
units.literal: I mistakenly listened to Helang and others' words, hoping to obtain blessings for all within the seas, but in the end there was no auspicious response.

units.zh: 皆違經背古，不合時宜。
units.en: All these proposals violate the classics and contradict ancient precedents, failing to suit the current era.
units.literal: All of these contravene the classics and oppose antiquity, not conforming to what is appropriate for the times.

units.zh: 六月甲子制書，非赦令也，皆蠲除之。
units.en: The imperial order issued on the jiazi day of the sixth month was not a pardon; all such measures are to be rescinded.
units.literal: The edict of the jiazi day in the sixth month was not an amnesty decree; all of them are to be remitted and eliminated.

units.zh: 賀良等反道惑眾，下有司。」
units.en: Helang and his associates defy moral principles and mislead the people; turn them over to the authorities.'
units.literal: Helang and others go against the Way and delude the masses; send them to the officials.'

units.zh: 皇天降非材之佑，漢國再獲受命之符，朕之不德，曷敢不通！
units.en: Heaven has sent protection to one unworthy such as I; the Han state has again received the token of the Mandate. My virtue is inadequate — how dare I not comply!
units.literal: Heaven has sent protection unworthy of one such as I; the Han state has again received the token of the Mandate. My virtue is inadequate — how dare I not comply!

units.zh: 夫基事之元命，必與天下自新，其大赦天下。
units.en: In founding matters of primal mandate, one must renew oneself together with all under Heaven. Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm.
units.literal: In founding matters of primal mandate, one must renew oneself with all under Heaven. Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm.

units.zh: 漏刻以百二十為度。」
units.en: The clepsydra gradations shall take one hundred twenty as the standard."
units.literal: The clepsydra gradations shall take one hundred twenty as the standard."

units.zh: 詔曰：「朕獲保宗廟，不明不敏，宿夜憂勞，未皇寧息。
units.en: An edict stated: "I have been able to preserve the ancestral temples, but I am neither enlightened nor quick in understanding. Day and night I labor in anxiety and have had no time for peaceful rest.
units.literal: An edict stated: "I have succeeded in preserving the ancestral temples, yet I am unenlightened and unperceptive; night and day I worry and labor, never at ease.

units.zh: 惟陰陽不調，元元不贍，未睹厥咎。
units.en: Yin and yang are not in harmony, the common people lack sustenance, and I have not seen where the fault lies.
units.literal: Only yin and yang are not in harmony, the common people lack sustenance, and I have not seen where the fault lies.

units.zh: 婁敕公卿，庶幾有望。
units.en: Time and again I have charged the high ministers, hoping for improvement.
units.literal: Time and again I have charged the high ministers, hoping for improvement.

units.zh: 至今有司執法，未得其中，或上暴虐，假勢獲名，溫良寬柔，陷於亡滅。
units.en: Even now, the officials who enforce the law have not found the proper balance. Some exalt the violent and cruel, borrowing power to win a name for themselves, while the gentle, good, lenient, and mild are driven into destruction.
units.literal: Until now the officials enforce the law without hitting the mean: some flatter the violent and cruel and gain reputation by borrowed power, while the mild, good, lenient, and gentle fall into ruin.

units.zh: 是故殘賊彌長，和睦日衰，百姓愁怨，靡所錯躬。
units.en: For this reason, cruelty and harm spread ever further, harmony declines day by day, and the common people grieve and resent, with nowhere to place themselves in safety.
units.literal: Therefore the cruel and harmful grow ever longer, concord daily declines, the hundred surnames grieve and resent, with nowhere to set themselves aright.

units.zh: 乃正月朔，日有蝕之，厥咎不遠，在余一人。
units.en: Now, on the new moon of the first month, the sun has been eclipsed. The fault is not far away; it lies in me alone.
units.literal: Then on the new moon of the first month there was a solar eclipse; the fault is not far off — it lies in me alone.

units.zh: 公卿大夫其各悉心勉帥百寮，敦任仁人，黜遠殘賊，期於安民。
units.en: Let the ministers and grandees each devote his whole heart to encouraging and leading the officials, earnestly appoint humane men, dismiss and keep far away the cruel and harmful, and make the people's security the goal.
units.literal: Let the ministers and great officers each with full heart exhort and lead the hundred offices, earnestly appoint benevolent men, dismiss and keep distant the cruel and harmful, and aim at settling the people.

units.zh: 陳朕之過失，無有所諱。
units.en: Set forth my faults and failings; let none be concealed.
units.literal: Set forth my faults and failings; let none be concealed.

units.zh: 其與將軍、列侯、中二千石舉賢良方正能直言者各一人。
units.en: Together with the generals, ranked marquises, and officials of two thousand bushels, each shall recommend one worthy, upright, and forthright person.
units.literal: Together with the generals, marquises, and officials of two thousand bushels, each shall recommend one person who is worthy, upright, and able to speak frankly.

units.zh: 大赦天下。」
units.en: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm."
units.literal: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm."

units.zh: 昭儀及根見上亡子，亦欲豫自結為長久計，皆更稱定陶王，勸帝以為嗣。
units.en: Consort Zhao and Wang Gen, observing that the emperor had no sons, wanted to secure their own long-term interests. They both spoke highly of the King of Dingtao and urged the emperor to name him as heir.
units.literal: Consort Zhao and Wang Gen, seeing that the emperor had no sons, also wished to secure themselves for the long term, and both spoke favorably of the King of Dingtao, urging the emperor to make him heir.

units.zh: 後月餘，立楚孝王孫景為定陶王，奉恭王祀，所以獎厲太子專為後之誼。
units.en: Over a month later, he installed Jing, grandson of King Xiao of Chu, as King of Dingtao to maintain the sacrifices to King Gong, thereby encouraging the Crown Prince to concentrate solely on securing the succession.
units.literal: More than a month later, he established King Xiao of Chu's grandson Jing as King of Dingtao to continue King Gong's sacrifices, in order to encourage and exhort the Crown Prince to focus single-mindedly on succession.

units.zh: 淮陽王舅張博、魏郡太守京房坐窺道諸侯王以邪意，漏泄省中語，博要斬，房棄市。
units.en: Zhang Bo, maternal uncle of the King of Huaiyang, and Jing Fang, governor of Wei commandery, were convicted of spying on the feudal kings with evil intent and leaking palace secrets. Bo was condemned to beheading, and Fang was executed in the marketplace.
units.literal: Huaiyang King maternal uncle Zhang Bo, Wei commandery governor Jing Fang convicted spied on feudal lords kings with evil intent, leaked revealed palace secret words, Bo condemned beheaded, Fang executed in marketplace.

units.zh: 魯公伯禽
units.en: Lu: Duke Bo Qin
units.literal: Lu Gong Bo Qin

units.zh: 康王釗，刑錯四十餘年。
units.en: King Kang (Zhao): for more than forty years punishments were laid aside.
units.literal: King Kang (Zhao); punishments were laid aside for more than forty years.

units.zh: 自上為太子時，以好色聞，及即位，皇太后詔采良家女。
units.en: From the time he was crown prince he was known for love of women. When he took the throne the empress dowager ordered the selection of maidens from reputable families.
units.literal: From the time he was crown prince he was known for love of women; when he took the throne the empress dowager ordered the selection of maidens from reputable families.

units.zh: 語在《元后傳》。
units.en: The full story is told in the biography of Empress Yuan.
units.literal: The words are in the biography of Empress Yuan.

units.zh: 時，帝舅大將軍王鳳以外戚輔政，求賢知自助。
units.en: Meanwhile the emperor's uncle, Grand General Wang Feng, ruled as regent through his maternal connection and cast about for able men to strengthen his hand.
units.literal: At this time the emperor's maternal uncle Grand General Wang Feng by affinal kin assisted government, seeking worthies and knowledge to help himself.

units.zh: 會皇太后女弟司馬君力與欽兄子私通，事上聞，欽慚懼，乞骸骨去。
units.en: Then it came out that the empress dowager's younger sister Sima Junli had carried on an affair with Qin's nephew. Qin, mortified and terrified, resigned his post.
units.literal: It happened that the empress dowager's younger sister Sima Junli had private intercourse with Qin's elder brother's son; the affair ascended to hearing; Qin was ashamed and afraid, begged bones and departed.

units.zh: 鳳白之太后，太后以為故事無有。
units.en: When Feng laid the memorial before the empress dowager, she replied that no precedent existed for what he proposed.
units.literal: Feng reported it to the empress dowager; the empress dowager thought by precedent there was none.

units.zh: 太后涕泣為不食。
units.en: The empress dowager wept and refused her meals for his sake.
units.literal: The empress dowager wept tears and for him did not eat.

units.zh: 母曰共哀許皇后，宣帝微時生民間。
units.en: His mother was Empress Xu, honored posthumously as Gongaiai; she gave birth to him while the future Emperor Xuan was still a private man living outside the court.
units.literal: His mother was Empress Xu, titled Gongaiai; she had borne him among the common people when Emperor Xuan was still obscure.

units.zh: 封外祖父平恩戴侯同產弟子中常侍許嘉為平恩侯，奉戴侯後。
units.en: Enfeoffed Xu Jia, Palace Regular Attendant and son of a full younger brother of the emperor's maternal grandfather, Marquis Dai of Ping'en, as Marquis of Ping'en to continue Marquis Dai's line.
units.literal: Enfeoffed Xu Jia, Palace Regular Attendant and son of a full younger brother of the maternal grandfather, Marquis Dai of Ping'en, as Marquis of Ping'en to continue Marquis Dai's line.

units.zh: 更始二年二月，发雒阳，欲入长安，司直李松奉引，车奔，触北宫铁柱门，三马皆死。
units.en: In the second month of Gengshi 2 (24), as the court left Luoyang for Chang'an, Director of Integrity Li Song's escort wagon ran away, smashed the iron-strapped gate of the Northern Palace, and killed all three horses.
units.literal: In the second month of the second year of Gengshi, setting out from Luoyang, intending to enter Chang'an, the Director of Integrity Li Song led the carriage-train; the carriage bolted, struck the iron-pillar gate of the Northern Palace, and all three horses died.
